On site

Life beyond the outing calendar

Not every beautiful moment requires a bus. The heated pool, garden courtyards, desert lounge, and restaurant terrace offer daily pleasures without leaving the residence.

With more than 300 sunny days a year, outdoor living is woven into everyday life — terrace mornings, pool afternoons, and candlelit evenings under the Atlas sky.

Beyond the residence

Marrakech and the Moroccan landscape

Marrakech is close enough for culture and connection — the medina, souks, palaces, and gardens are part of our regular calendar. Further afield, the sea, desert, and Atlas foothills offer excursions planned with comfort, adapted transport, and attentive accompaniment.

Signature residents enjoy additional benefits: a private chauffeur three days per week and fifteen holiday days per year by the sea or in the mountains.
